import threading
import random

def create_connection(host, port):

    sock.settimeout(1)
    sock.bind((host, port))
    sock.connect((host, port))
    return sock

    node = threading.Thread(target=create_connection)
    node.daemon = True
    node.start()
    return node

    sock.connect((host, port))
    return sock

    node = create_connection(host, port)
    node.start()
    return node
